capability: Evaluate the 32-term Faddeeva variant with its default order and declared failure contract.
discovery.boundary: Real axis is accepted; exponential continuation overflow raises.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError for non-finite/empty phase points, a nonpositive or out-of-range integer order, or an unsupported pole count.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: FloatingPointError when the continued fraction or pole sum exceeds float64 range; no silent clamp is applied.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Fixed-order approximation has no iterative convergence claim; truncation error is bounded only on the tested envelopes.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial value is returned after a failed call.

scope: test_defaults_and_independent_complex_error_function, test_imaginary_axis_overflow_regression and test_fft_normalization_and_reflection directly exercise GPDF defaults, matrix shape, the named positive-imaginary-axis regression and reflection. test_invalid_truncation, test_explicit_empty_and_overflow and test_large_real_finite_response directly cover invalid orders, None default, lower-plane overflow rejection and large finite phase points.
test_high_precision_equation_grid directly compares GPDF with the 80-digit mpmath equation using its entry-specific tolerances. The 70-digit Gaussian Cauchy integral calls J-pole, not GPDF.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Direct and dependency evidence are separated in scope above; named assertions are in tests/kinetic/test_generalized_dispersion_faddeeva_variants.py and tests/kinetic/test_generalized_dispersion_faddeeva_independent.py. Entry-specific comparisons retain the tolerances of those assertions and apply only to their sampled phase points and orders. Shared files do not confer every assertion on every entry point. No global error bound, arbitrary-distribution response or experimental validation is established.
known_limitations: Fixed truncation error depends on phase point and order.
Direct GPDF failure and boundary assertions are present, but their sampled phase points and orders do not establish a global error or representability guarantee.

title.zh: 计算 32 阶 Faddeeva 变体

summary: Evaluate the 32-term Faddeeva variant with its default order and declared failure contract.

identity.definition: Weideman rational FFT expansion with erfcx on imaginary axis.
identity.boundary: Real axis is accepted; exponential continuation overflow raises.

supported: Finite nonempty scalar or array input; shape preserved.
preconditions: All phase values and computed results fit complex128.

inputs.name: order
inputs.description: Rational truncation or pole count. None selects order 32.
inputs.constraints: Any positive integer order. Boolean rejected.

example.code:
from scirel.kinetic import evaluate_faddeeva_gpdf
import numpy as np
r=evaluate_faddeeva_gpdf(0.2+0.7j)
assert np.isfinite(r["w"])
example.expected: Observed PASS: Finite complex response at the effective order.

references: Weideman (1994), Computation of the Complex Error Function, doi:10.1137/0731077
Xie (2013), Generalized Plasma Dispersion Function, arXiv:1305.6476
